_doc: COHERENCE-AGREE-7 (REVIEW-AGREE-2 F8 (ii), the chair's ruling of 2026-11-12): the walker's third member — the private readers of the four atoms the defence home holds that the first two members never named (the palisade, the prison, the hospital and the healer; `tests/lint/defenceFactReaders.shared.mjs :: ATOM_WORDS`, member 3), outside src/domain/facts/, src/domain/defense/ and src/data/, counted by tests/lint/defenceFactReaders.walker.test.js. SHRINK-ONLY from its first commit: a row may only fall, and falls the commit its reader retires to the home; no row is ever added. Banked over 293167b6f, after the lane's own two readers (the flag bag's prison, a9d2bc1cf, and hospital, 293167b6f) were cured rather than banked: every row here predates the lane. Two shapes are ruled out by rule, not banked: a name list tested against a person's role archetype (worldPulse/npcGoalBranches.js) and an agreement check that reads the home's own answer on the same line (summary/settlementQuickGuide.js).

src/domain/display/stateProse/generalSta.reason: Counted, and reads the home: `const hasHospital = record ? defenceOf(record).hospital : inst.hasHospital` sets the flag over two lines, the home's answer first (CENSUS-1b unit A (b)); the line-shaped count cannot see the next line, so the row is held as counted (present at 99bcc6944)
